title: The Obelisk Gate
author: N. K. Jemisin
summary: Second in a trilogy set on a planet wrecked by regular apocalyptic upheavals. A woman who can command the earth and her young daughter, who has the same gift, each look for a place of safety in a hostile world.
readIf: you like layered, angry fantasy with a harsh world and a strong focus on mothers and daughters.
skipIf: you haven't read The Fifth Season, because this novel continues directly from it.

pairings.reason: A powerful story of a young woman building a community in a collapsing world.
A bleaker, quieter account of a parent trying to protect a child after the world ends.
A short, searing novel about power, bondage and survival through generations.
